column1: # Search words that mean the same thing (docs/AGENT_ASSET_STORE.md §8). One group per line: a
# query word in a group also matches the group's other words, ranked a little below an exact
# match. `@category` lines are hints only: they pick the nearest rows for a query that found
# nothing (`@character` routes to the character tools; `@clip` to `assets kind=clip`).
wood wooden timber oak plank lumber
light lamp lantern torch candle brazier sconce
attack strike swing slash punch kick
@vegetation tree trees bush shrub plant flower grass hedge
@character character person human people npc hero villager monster creature figure
@clip animation motion clip move moves gesture emote
